title: Lahaina water use permit applications and TIG report
summary: On August 20, the Maui County Board of Water Supply voted unanimously to approve the Temporary Investigative Group (TIG) report on water use permit applications in the Lahaina surface and groundwater management area, to be sent to the state Commission on Water Resource Management (CWRM). The report found requests of almost 9 million gallons a day, 213% of reported existing use, and called the sustainable yield numbers indefensible as regulatory rules. It recommends reviewing surface and groundwater applications together and a full monitoring program before non-conditional permits.
